manifest.reference_scale: Stockfish UCI_Elo; documented calibration is 120 seconds + 1 second increment

method: fixed-N conservative paired KL/Chernoff bound; independent pair assumption
rating_caveat: Opponent-setting reference scale, not FIDE/CCRL rating; calibration depends on time control and pool.

calibration.inference: Discovery batches select the opponent. Only fresh fixed-size confirmation games determine the final rating interval.

followup_validation.primary_inference: Always retain the original fixed 48-game confirmation at 1600, regardless of follow-up results. Do not select or refit its confidence interval using later games.
followup_validation.trigger: After all 48 finish, combine their score with discovery observations to check the 40–60% target band.
followup_validation.followup: If outside the band, use the existing bracket/midpoint rule for fresh 12-game validation batches. Record each batch before play. Include validation in level selection but never in the primary rating interval.

equilibrium_search.stopping_reason: Observed crossover reached the declared 25-Elo grid resolution. No exact equal-strength setting is claimed; Stockfish limiting control can have discrete selection-depth steps.
equilibrium_search.rating_interval_caveat: This is an observed crossover, not a confidence interval for the engine rating. Primary inference uses only the original fixed 48 games.

resolution_stop_declaration.recorded_before: Inspection of the completed 1425 batch result; the batch is already declared and running.
resolution_stop_declaration.reason: Stockfish 19 chooses the weakened move at a depth determined by an integer skill component. The reference control can have steps, so an exactly even selectable opponent is not guaranteed.
resolution_stop_declaration.stopping: Complete all 12 games at 1425. Stop if an observed score enters the 40–60% band, or if the observed crossover bracket is at most the existing 25-Elo grid resolution. Report the bracket explicitly, not as a 95% rating interval or proof of equal strength.
resolution_stop_declaration.primary_inference: Original fixed 48-game result and interval remain unchanged. Retain every result; no repeated endpoint batches to obtain a favorable score.
